comparison.position: 只看最终成功会把最短路线、绕路成功和接近完成的失败混成同一结果。DetourBench把环境限制为有限、确定、部分可观察的资源／凭证状态机，资源标识发现后全局可寻址，没有当前位置或回退路费。离线评测器知道全图，用BFS给出最少收费访问数和可回放见证；这不是部分可观察条件下的最优策略。
comparison.tradeoff: 负控覆盖重复／无效都收费、batch终态截断、部分进展、不可逆失败的null指标与状态上限。三seed是同一确定性边界测试的重复，不是三次独立能力实验。与Harness²相比，这里有全信息exact evaluator；Harness²是无rubric的执行对照改进，不能把其选择器当最短路oracle。

analysis.title: DetourBench：把成功、绕路和不可逆失败分开
analysis.body: 每次真正送达dispatcher的访问都收费，包括无效、禁用和重复动作；不产生访问的模型回复不收费，另有turn上限。batch按顺序执行，达到终态或固定预算便停止。活跃状态下资源与凭证只增不减，错误承诺是吸收终态，不给它编造一个有限剩余距离。成功率必须与条件attainment一起报告，不能用只在成功子集上定义的效率排整个模型名次。 负控覆盖重复／无效都收费、batch终态截断、部分进展、不可逆失败的null指标与状态上限。三seed是同一确定性边界测试的重复，不是三次独立能力实验。与Harness²相比，这里有全信息exact evaluator；Harness²是无rubric的执行对照改进，不能把其选择器当最短路oracle。

question.question: 它与Harness²的执行比较有什么不同？
question.answer: DetourBench评价固定轨迹与可证明离线最短路；Harness²通过真实执行对照改harness，选择不依赖gold或rubric。两者评价对象和信息权限不同。
question.example: 教学例：匿名选产物不能证明该产物花的访问数最少。

update.summary: FiniteTask执行资源／凭证前置条件、收费batch和BFS精确见证；metrics分别保留成功、错误终态、剩余距离和效率。合成图只验证算子，不运行LLM，也不把BFS答案喂给策略。100,000状态上限触发时明确报错，绝不退成近似下界冒充exact。未实现官方任务源语料、远程端点或哈希冻结全链。 完整实验高成本不复现，不作能力证据。

comparison.position: Endpoint success conflates direct execution, circuitous success and recoverable near misses. DetourBench restricts tasks to finite deterministic partially observed resource/credential systems. Discovered identifiers remain globally addressable, with no current-location or backtracking charge. An evaluator with the complete graph uses BFS to compute a minimum charged-access reference and replayable witness. This is not the optimal partially observed policy.
comparison.tradeoff: Controls cover charged invalid/duplicate accesses, terminal batch truncation, partial progress, undefined wrong-terminal measures and the search cap. Three seeds repeat deterministic boundary checks, not independent capability trials. Unlike Harness², this uses a full-information exact evaluator; Harness² performs rubric-free execution contrasts and its selector is not a shortest-path oracle.

analysis.title: detourbench: distinguish mechanism from capability
analysis.body: Every access dispatched to the environment costs one, including invalid, disabled and duplicate calls. Model replies without accesses are free but bounded separately by a turn cap. Batches stop at a terminal state or the fixed budget. Resources and credentials grow monotonically while active. Wrong commitment is absorbing and has no finite residual distance. Conditional attainment must accompany success; successful-subset efficiency alone cannot rank models. Controls cover charged invalid/duplicate accesses, terminal batch truncation, partial progress, undefined wrong-terminal measures and the search cap. Three seeds repeat deterministic boundary checks, not independent capability trials. Unlike Harness², this uses a full-information exact evaluator; Harness² performs rubric-free execution contrasts and its selector is not a shortest-path oracle.

question.question: How does this differ from Harness² execution comparison?
question.answer: DetourBench measures a fixed trajectory against a provable offline minimum. Harness² changes a harness through execution contrasts without gold or rubrics. Their objects and information privileges differ.
question.example: Teaching example: choosing an anonymous artifact does not prove its access count was minimal.

english.update: FiniteTask executes resource/credential prerequisites, charged batches and exact BFS witnesses. Metrics retain success, wrong terminals, residual distance and efficiency separately. Synthetic graphs test the mechanism, not an LLM; BFS answers are not passed to any policy. Exceeding100,000 states raises an error rather than returning an approximate bound labeled exact. Official source corpora, endpoints and the complete hash-freeze pipeline are absent. Full campaign not reproduced; no capability claim.

comparison.position: Agent需要给未知材料设计加热实验，用可能粗糙或缺物理项的热传导模拟器估计物性，再报告95%区间与隐藏实验的预测。拟合残差小不代表模型正确：错误物理可给出看似精确但偏置的参数。环境让“真实样品”由更丰富模拟器生成，评测器有精确truth，Agent只得到工具、初始测量和预算。
comparison.tradeoff: 负控验证过窄错误区间代价、区间加宽不免费、单位倍数变换不改log区间评分，以及非正值／NaN／漏参数拒绝。AskALCF用回答盲的两范围证据定位检索责任；本篇用独立物理truth评分置信区间。二者都要求评测参考不能进入被评Agent，但不能互换judgment。

analysis.title: SciResearch-Eval：用正确区间评分检验科学判断
analysis.body: 物性区间在log10尺度上使用proper interval score：区间越宽承担宽度代价，错过truth另以40倍距离处罚。隐藏温度预测另按传感噪声sigma及真实温升归一化，不能和物性log评分混成一个accuracy。无提交单独保存，论文覆盖率把它算miss；不能只统计按时提交的成功子集。 负控验证过窄错误区间代价、区间加宽不免费、单位倍数变换不改log区间评分，以及非正值／NaN／漏参数拒绝。AskALCF用回答盲的两范围证据定位检索责任；本篇用独立物理truth评分置信区间。二者都要求评测参考不能进入被评Agent，但不能互换judgment。

question.question: 它与AskALCF回答盲探针的参考信息一样吗？
question.answer: 不一样。本篇evaluator有精确物理truth，AskALCF充分性探针只看问题和文档，不能看生成答案。参考对象和权限必须分别隔离。
question.example: 教学例：热物性真值可以供评分器用，但不能传给实验设计Agent。

update.summary: 本地只执行interval_score与parameter_score：正值物性先取log10，检查端点有序、有限与key完全一致。evaluator_truth没有Actor回调入口；它是评分器专用参数，不是给被评策略的信息。未实现热求解器、实验选择、拟合、科学家LLM或无提交聚合，不据此宣称科学任务复现。 完整实验高成本不复现，不作能力证据。

comparison.position: An agent designs heating experiments for an unknown material, fits a supplied heat-conduction simulator that may be under-resolved or physically incomplete, and submits95% property intervals plus a hidden-experiment prediction. Small residuals need not imply a correct model: missing physics can yield precise but biased estimates. A richer hidden simulator supplies exact evaluator truth; the actor receives tools, measurements and budgets only.
comparison.tradeoff: Controls verify the narrow-miss penalty, nonfree widening, invariance to multiplicative unit changes, and rejection of nonpositive/NaN/missing parameters. AskALCF uses answer-blind evidence scopes for attribution; this benchmark scores uncertainty against independent physical truth. Both isolate evaluation references, but their judgments are not interchangeable.

analysis.title: sciresearch-eval: distinguish mechanism from capability
analysis.body: Physical-property intervals use a proper interval score on log10 values: width is penalized and miscoverage adds40 times the missed distance. Hidden temperature predictions are separately normalized by sensor sigma and true temperature rise. These are not one accuracy metric. Missing submissions remain explicit and count as coverage misses in the paper; dropping them would bias evaluation. Controls verify the narrow-miss penalty, nonfree widening, invariance to multiplicative unit changes, and rejection of nonpositive/NaN/missing parameters. AskALCF uses answer-blind evidence scopes for attribution; this benchmark scores uncertainty against independent physical truth. Both isolate evaluation references, but their judgments are not interchangeable.

question.question: Is its reference information the same as an AskALCF sufficiency probe?
question.answer: No. This evaluator has exact physical truth. AskALCF sufficiency sees only question and documents, not generation. Each reference and permission boundary must remain separate.
question.example: Teaching example: a scorer may use conductivity truth; the experiment-design actor may not.

english.update: The local slice runs interval_score and parameter_score. Positive physical quantities are converted to log10; endpoints, finiteness and exact parameter keys are checked. evaluator_truth has no actor callback path and belongs only to the scorer. No thermal solver, design selection, fitting, scientist LLM or missing-submission aggregation is implemented. This is not a scientific-capability reproduction. Full campaign not reproduced; no capability claim.

comparison.position: API返回HTTP200并不保证按请求过滤，静默忽略字段、把AND变OR或截断total都可能让Agent相信错误数据。SilentGuard把检查从提示中的建议移到执行harness：结果过确定性不变量才放行，失败真实重试一次，仍失败时按检查可信度隐藏值或警告，不自动生成“修复值”。
comparison.tradeoff: 负控包含一致谎言确实放行、97/98个clean样本的阈值边界、documented参数拒绝、原API error透传、宽松count不能背书严格请求，以及两次拒绝后弃答。与Harness²改进执行策略不同，这里只限制结果能否被使用；判定“可验证”不等于开放任务能力。

analysis.title: SilentGuard：把API一致性检查变成强制执行门
analysis.body: 计数查询对每个条件i执行N(F)+N(F不含i且非Ci)=N(F不含i)，每次最多2k额外API查询。文档外参数可在执行前拒绝。精确检查误报估计0；learned contract从n条clean样本估1/(n+2)，不大于1%才强制隐藏。最终count必须来自足够严格且已通过检查的查询，否则拒绝最多两次再弃答。 负控包含一致谎言确实放行、97/98个clean样本的阈值边界、documented参数拒绝、原API error透传、宽松count不能背书严格请求，以及两次拒绝后弃答。与Harness²改进执行策略不同，这里只限制结果能否被使用；判定“可验证”不等于开放任务能力。

question.question: 为什么不把这个当Harness²式自改进？
question.answer: SilentGuard按固定不变量执行放行／隐藏，不提出或整合harness改动；Harness²需要执行对照和经验积累。两者可组合但不互相替代。
question.example: 教学例：重发一次API不是生成一个新的工具策略候选。

update.summary: 本地guarded_count实际调用API回调及辅助查询，失败真实重发原调用一次；无效count删去而不是返回0。action_for_checks实现learned/exact阈值；AnswerGate跟踪查询条件数，防止用宽松查询的verified count替代更严格请求。只支持计数切片，未实现列表验证、contract miner、值交换检查、模型或训练。 完整实验高成本不复现，不作能力证据。

comparison.position: HTTP200 does not establish that an API applied the requested filters. SilentGuard moves checks from optional prompt advice into the execution harness. Results must satisfy invariants, a failing request is actually retried once, and repeated failures lead to withholding or warning according to check reliability. It never invents a repaired value.
comparison.tradeoff: Controls include a consistent lie that correctly remains undetected, the97/98 clean-example cutoff, unknown-parameter rejection, API-error passthrough, loose-query provenance and bounded rejection. Unlike Harness² policy improvement, this component controls whether evidence may be used; verifiability is not an open-task capability score.

analysis.title: silentguard: distinguish mechanism from capability
analysis.body: For every conditioni, count checks testN(F)+N(F without i and not Ci)=N(F without i), requiring up to2k additional queries. Undocumented parameters can be rejected before execution. Exact checks have zero false-alarm estimate; learned contracts use1/(n+2) fromn clean examples and withhold only at a cutoff of1%. Final counts must originate from a sufficiently restrictive checked query; two rejected submissions are followed by abstention. Controls include a consistent lie that correctly remains undetected, the97/98 clean-example cutoff, unknown-parameter rejection, API-error passthrough, loose-query provenance and bounded rejection. Unlike Harness² policy improvement, this component controls whether evidence may be used; verifiability is not an open-task capability score.

question.question: Why is this not Harness²-style self-improvement?
question.answer: SilentGuard applies fixed release/withhold rules. It does not propose or integrate harness edits; Harness² requires execution contrasts and accumulated experience. They can compose but are not substitutes.
question.example: Teaching example: retrying an API once is not proposing a new tool policy.

english.update: guarded_count actually invokes the API and auxiliary queries, retries the original call once, and removes unverified counts rather than replacing them with zero. action_for_checks implements exact/learned cutoff decisions. AnswerGate tracks filter counts so a looser verified query cannot support a stricter request. The slice omits list checks, contract mining, value swaps, LLMs and training. Full campaign not reproduced; no capability claim.

comparison.position: 自然语言教训改变偏好，却不能保证不可逆动作不执行。MetaAct让LLM输出类型化GEAR规格，由固定编译器转成确定性guard；运行时拒绝违反约束的动作并返触发消息，模型需要重新规划。保证只覆盖规格表达的局部规则，不是全任务安全证明。
comparison.tradeoff: 合成日志验证观察变化后动作恢复可用、已生效选项被拦、有效动作误拦和成功轨迹误拦会拒绝、缺正负参考时不打虚假零率。成功和score标签只供离线evaluator，guard只能见动作前View。与Harness²基于开放执行对照组合不同，这里选择有明确作用域的可执行约束，回放通过并不证明真实环境收益。

analysis.title: MetaAct：类型化动作约束与离线回放验证
analysis.body: v1提出ordered_once、no_op_repeat、idempotence_block、revisit_block、generic_deref、relevance_filter六类primitive及固定extractor菜单。候选用训练日志反事实回放，要求失败轨迹覆盖至少0.3、有效动作误拦不高于0.15、成功轨迹被拦不高于0.10。有效动作分母来自成功及高分失败的安全参考，不把本来无效的重复动作充成误拦。 合成日志验证观察变化后动作恢复可用、已生效选项被拦、有效动作误拦和成功轨迹误拦会拒绝、缺正负参考时不打虚假零率。成功和score标签只供离线evaluator，guard只能见动作前View。与Harness²基于开放执行对照组合不同，这里选择有明确作用域的可执行约束，回放通过并不证明真实环境收益。

question.question: 与Harness²组合候选相比，GEAR union能直接采用吗？
question.answer: 不能。GEAR union是guard合取，拦截更多动作也可能误伤成功轨迹，必须重新回放；Harness²也要求实际执行组合结果，证据类型不同。
question.example: 教学例：两个各自安全的约束合并后仍需算eff和ok。

update.summary: 本地独立实现已核的no_op_repeat和idempotence_block两种guard，以及Eq2–5回放评分／union选择；明确不含其余四primitive、goal extractor、LLM综合和在线retirement。安全参考score阈值必须显式提供，不把教学0.5当论文统一常数。未知primitive严格拒绝，不静默跳过；上游当前repo比v1多primitive，不能据此改写原论文事实。 完整实验高成本不复现，不作能力证据。

comparison.position: Natural-language lessons affect preference without guaranteeing that an irreversible action is blocked. MetaAct has an LLM write typed GEAR specifications, compiled by a fixed compiler into deterministic guards. Rejected actions return trigger messages for replanning. Guarantees are local to represented constraints, not full-task safety proofs.
comparison.tradeoff: Synthetic logs verify restoration after observation changes, blocking already-effective options, rejection for harmful effective/success blocking and refusal to score without positive/negative references. Success and score labels belong only to the replay evaluator; guards receive pre-action View. Unlike Harness² open execution composition, this selects scoped executable constraints. Passing replay does not establish environment benefit.

analysis.title: metaact: distinguish mechanism from capability
analysis.body: Fixedv1 defines six primitives: ordered_once, no_op_repeat, idempotence_block, revisit_block, generic_deref and relevance_filter, with a fixed extractor menu. Offline training-log replay requires failure coverage≥0.3, effective-action blocking≤0.15 and successful-trajectory blocking≤0.10. The effective-action denominator uses successful and high-scoring failed safety references; intended no-op suppression is not counted as false blocking. Synthetic logs verify restoration after observation changes, blocking already-effective options, rejection for harmful effective/success blocking and refusal to score without positive/negative references. Success and score labels belong only to the replay evaluator; guards receive pre-action View. Unlike Harness² open execution composition, this selects scoped executable constraints. Passing replay does not establish environment benefit.

question.question: Can a GEAR union be adopted without evaluation unlike Harness² composition?
question.answer: No. Conjunction can block more actions and harm successful traces, so replay is repeated. Harness² likewise executes compositions, but uses a different evidence type.
question.example: Teaching example: recompute eff and ok even when both separate guards passed.

english.update: The local independent slice implements two verified guards, no_op_repeat and idempotence_block, plus Eq2–5 replay scoring and union selection. It omits four primitives, goal extractors, LLM synthesis and online retirement. The safety-reference score threshold must be supplied explicitly; a teaching value of0.5 is not a paper-wide constant. Unknown primitives raise errors. The pinned upstream repository already has more primitives thanv1 and does not redefine the paper. Full campaign not reproduced; no capability claim.

comparison.position: ELITE质疑反复在固定下游任务上evaluate-and-select的成本与适应偏差。冻结模型，演化可执行scaffold代码：同一parent先给出多个聚焦改进假设，每条假设独立实现，经过确定性有效性检查后交给LLM integrator。它不是从得分最高子代里挑一个。
comparison.tradeoff: 负控验证两次explorer确实看到相同parent、integrator收到独立子代、严格范围拒绝、acceptance失败回滚和无效gate不被truthiness放行。与Harness²相比，两者都不依赖任务rubric，但Harness²按任务执行对照改框架，ELITE刻意不看下游执行结局，不能把普通validation elitism写成ELITE。

analysis.title: ELITE：同父探索后按实现证据整合，不做任务分数选择
analysis.body: integrator查看实现、hypothesis与gate结果，推理互补、冗余、冲突、复杂度或缺失，再对原parent重新实现一个组合patch。不能简单拼接所有patch，也不能把已串联修改的子代当共同起点。compile/import/tool-load/scope等exploration gate与更严格call-return/message-order/main-flow acceptance gate只验证操作有效性；下游解题轨迹和benchmark结果都不进入演化。 负控验证两次explorer确实看到相同parent、integrator收到独立子代、严格范围拒绝、acceptance失败回滚和无效gate不被truthiness放行。与Harness²相比，两者都不依赖任务rubric，但Harness²按任务执行对照改框架，ELITE刻意不看下游执行结局，不能把普通validation elitism写成ELITE。

question.question: ELITE与Harness²都无rubric，差别在哪里？
question.answer: Harness²会运行任务并比较行为来组合；ELITE用实现级证据且排除下游任务结果。二者“无rubric”不意味着相同信息边界。
question.example: 教学例：给ELITE integrator一张候选成功率表已经改变算法。

update.summary: 本地L0 generation真实调用独立explore、exploration_gate、integrate、acceptance_gate；共同parent映射不可变，越界／空patch和非bool门结果拒绝。IntegrationRequest只有parent与有效children，不接收任务成绩／轨迹。失败acceptance或无有效子代保留原parent，不选择“次优分数”。回调可编译示例源码但没有LLM、SWE容器或安全沙箱。 完整实验高成本不复现，不作能力证据。

comparison.position: ELITE questions the cost and adaptation bias of repeated downstream evaluate-and-select. With a frozen model, it evolves executable scaffold code: multiple focused hypotheses are independently implemented from one parent and deterministic-valid children are passed to an LLM integrator. It does not select the highest-scoring child.
comparison.tradeoff: Controls verify identical parent inputs, independent children, edit-scope enforcement, acceptance rollback and strict gate types. Both ELITE and Harness² avoid task rubrics, but Harness² uses task-execution contrasts whereas ELITE excludes downstream outcomes. Ordinary validation elitism must not be relabeled ELITE.

analysis.title: elite-eval-free: distinguish mechanism from capability
analysis.body: The integrator examines code, hypotheses and gate evidence, reasons about complementarity, redundancy, conflict, complexity and missing pieces, then reimplements a combined patch against the original parent. It neither concatenates patches nor uses an already sequentially modified child as the common root. Exploration and stricter acceptance gates check operational validity; downstream solving trajectories and benchmark results never guide evolution. Controls verify identical parent inputs, independent children, edit-scope enforcement, acceptance rollback and strict gate types. Both ELITE and Harness² avoid task rubrics, but Harness² uses task-execution contrasts whereas ELITE excludes downstream outcomes. Ordinary validation elitism must not be relabeled ELITE.

question.question: How does ELITE differ from rubric-free Harness²?
question.answer: Harness² runs tasks and compares behavior; ELITE integrates implementation-level evidence while excluding downstream task outcomes. Rubric-free does not imply identical information boundaries.
question.example: Teaching example: handing ELITE an offspring success-rate table changes the algorithm.

english.update: The L0 generation protocol actually calls independent explorer, exploration gate, integrator and acceptance-gate callbacks. A shared parent is immutable; empty/out-of-scope patches and non-Boolean gates are rejected. IntegrationRequest contains only parent and valid children, not scores or solving traces. Failed acceptance or no valid children retains the original parent. Compilation of teaching code is not an LLM, SWE container or security sandbox. Full campaign not reproduced; no capability claim.

comparison.position: 自进化停滞不一定是提案不够好，可能是一次嘈杂评分分不清候选改进。本文把“同一artifact反复测”的评测噪声与“不同演化run产出不同artifact”的真实质量波动分开。固定artifact的对照只受前者限制，方法排名同时受两者限制。
comparison.tradeoff: 负控用相同行的嘈杂数据得到负tau²、无行内噪声但均值不同得到正tau²，并检验整体平移不改变方差、ragged/NaN/bool拒绝。Harness²的执行对照也会有随机性；本估计器只是诊断测量分辨率，不把其输出直接变成自动晋级门。

analysis.title: Resolution Hypothesis：区分评测噪声与演化run方差
analysis.body: 在R个独立artifact、每个M次重复评测的平衡矩阵中，sigma²用每行sample variance再平均，tau²用行均值sample variance减sigma²/M。tau²的无偏矩估计可以为负；不能删掉负结果，论文只在显示标准差时截成0。把所有RM项拉平会破坏层级，不能用更多同artifact重复代替更多独立演化run。 负控用相同行的嘈杂数据得到负tau²、无行内噪声但均值不同得到正tau²，并检验整体平移不改变方差、ragged/NaN/bool拒绝。Harness²的执行对照也会有随机性；本估计器只是诊断测量分辨率，不把其输出直接变成自动晋级门。

question.question: 它能取代Harness²的selector吗？
question.answer: 不能。它估测量波动，不判断哪条机制互补或哪个产物更符合任务。候选质量、选择能力与分辨率是不同对象。

update.summary: variance_components执行附录B.2的两个估计，返回负的run_variance_unbiased与仅截断的run_sd，要求至少2×2平衡有限数值矩阵。输入必须是已经测量且来源明确的结果；模块不生成agent轨迹、不选择候选，也不伪造方差置信区间或powered superiority。 完整实验高成本不复现，不作能力证据。

comparison.position: Evolution can stall because a noisy evaluation cannot recognize useful candidates, not because proposals lack improvements. The paper separates repeated-evaluation noise for one artifact from true-quality variation across artifacts produced by independent evolution runs. Fixed-artifact comparisons face the former; method rankings face both.
comparison.tradeoff: Controls cover noisy identical rows yielding negative tau², noiseless but different run means yielding positive tau², translation invariance and invalid ragged/NaN/Boolean data. Harness² execution contrasts can also be stochastic. These estimators diagnose resolution and are not an automatic promotion gate.

analysis.title: resolution-hypothesis: distinguish mechanism from capability
analysis.body: ForR independent artifacts evaluatedM times each, sigma² is the average within-row sample variance. The unbiased moment estimate of tau² subtracts sigma²/M from the sample variance of row means. It can be negative and must be retained; only the displayed run standard deviation clips to zero. Flattening allRM observations destroys the hierarchy, and more evaluations of one artifact do not replace independent evolution runs. Controls cover noisy identical rows yielding negative tau², noiseless but different run means yielding positive tau², translation invariance and invalid ragged/NaN/Boolean data. Harness² execution contrasts can also be stochastic. These estimators diagnose resolution and are not an automatic promotion gate.

question.question: Can it replace the Harness² selector?
question.answer: No. It estimates measurement variability, not mechanism compatibility or task fitness. Candidate quality, selection and evaluation resolution are distinct objects.

english.update: variance_components implements AppendixB.2, returning the negative unbiased run-variance estimate alongside a clipped run SD. It requires a balanced finite matrix of at least2×2. Inputs must be already measured and provenance-backed. The module neither creates agent trajectories, selects candidates, invents variance intervals nor establishes powered superiority. Full campaign not reproduced; no capability claim.

comparison.position: CLAM把可积累的参数记忆与逐字检索缓冲分开：冻结LLM提供每层会话activation，hypernetwork在不做测试时梯度下降的情况下写出down_proj LoRA，查询时再配top5会话片段。没有提取调用不等于没有前置训练；能力来自离线context distillation。
comparison.tradeoff: CoReMem通过未来同仓库任务的有／无记忆差估值并训练写入信用；CLAM通过全历史teacher蒸馏把history压进权重。前者是前瞻效用，后者是参数通道，两者都不能用静态摘要相似度冒充任务收益。完整实验成本过高，不复现（审查DONE）。

analysis.title: CLAM：会话流压缩到固定大小的参数记忆
analysis.body: Read用9层Perceiver cross-attention、每层8slots，slots只看当前会话。Carry先对slots做一次8头self-attention，再对每slot产生一个sigmoid门混合旧Q与新x，并LayerNorm。Decode用每层每rank一个query生成rank8 adapter，大小不随会话数增加；合成模型还含固定bias。顺序和门不能被普通均值池化替代。 CoReMem通过未来同仓库任务的有／无记忆差估值并训练写入信用；CLAM通过全历史teacher蒸馏把history压进权重。前者是前瞻效用，后者是参数通道，两者都不能用静态摘要相似度冒充任务收益。完整实验成本过高，不复现（审查DONE）。

question.question: CLAM与CoReMem都写memory，有何关键区别？
question.answer: CLAM蒸馏全历史答案生成参数；CoReMem以未来任务有无记忆差值训练信用。前者不是后者的低成本替身。
question.example: 教学例：记住一个姓名不等于证明下一仓库任务节省步骤。

update.summary: 本轮review-only，不提供可执行adapter、metrics或GPU验证，不下载权重／合成语料。只把v1的read/carry/decode、两阶段训练、rank与检索协议记录为可核对方法；把随机初始化hypernetwork跑一次不能算完成记忆巩固。 完整实验高成本不复现，不作能力证据。

comparison.position: CLAM separates accumulative parametric memory from verbatim episodic retrieval. A frozen LLM supplies per-layer session activations; a hypernetwork emits down_proj LoRA weights without test-time gradient descent, supplemented by top-five session pieces at query time. No extraction calls does not mean no prior training: capability comes from offline context distillation.
comparison.tradeoff: CoReMem values memory by future same-repository with/without-memory replay and trains provenance credit. CLAM distills full-history teacher behavior into weights. Prospective utility and a parametric memory channel are different; neither is validated by static summary similarity. Full experiment not reproduced due to cost(reviewDONE).

analysis.title: clam-memory: distinguish mechanism from capability
analysis.body: Read uses nine Perceiver cross-attention blocks with eight latent slots, each reading only session tokens. Carry applies one eight-head slot self-attention block, then one sigmoid gate per slot mixes oldQ with newx and LayerNorm stabilizes it. Decode uses one query per layer/rank pair to produce fixed rank-eight adapters plus a learned fixed bias. Adapter size does not grow with sessions; mean pooling is not a substitute. CoReMem values memory by future same-repository with/without-memory replay and trains provenance credit. CLAM distills full-history teacher behavior into weights. Prospective utility and a parametric memory channel are different; neither is validated by static summary similarity. Full experiment not reproduced due to cost(reviewDONE).

question.question: How does CLAM differ from CoReMem?
question.answer: CLAM distills full-history answers into parameters. CoReMem uses future-task with/without-memory value for credit. Neither is a cheap stand-in for the other.

comparison.position: 手工给Agent正确skill测的是精选上界，不等于部署时能从库里找到它。SkillBuffBench在同一任务／模型／harness下交叉三种skill访问（无、精选、自动）与两种memory模式，单独测内容收益、发现损失和记忆交互。模型池和harness版本应固定到每次结果，不能把更新后版本混进同一格。
comparison.tradeoff: Harness²会产生与改进执行框架；SkillBuffBench评估框架、模型、skill access和memory条件的配对差异。让改进过程看测试任务的verifier会同时改变二者的信息边界。精选skill不应被写成自动发现能力。

analysis.title: SkillBuffBench：把精选技能、自动发现与记忆分开评测
analysis.body: M0每轮新workspace、session和memory namespace，缓存／历史不跨轮；只有API凭据可复用。任务prompt不点名skill，golden值、reference solution和verifier不给Agent。网络默认只开模型API，必要外部工具逐任务allowlist；私有技能正文不能靠摘要重写成声称同等的benchmark。 Harness²会产生与改进执行框架；SkillBuffBench评估框架、模型、skill access和memory条件的配对差异。让改进过程看测试任务的verifier会同时改变二者的信息边界。精选skill不应被写成自动发现能力。

question.question: 为什么它不能直接等同Harness²实验？
question.answer: 这里固定配置比较skill access与memory条件，Harness²主动修改harness并积累经验。演化产物与评测条件必须分开。

update.summary: 本轮review-only，无模型矩阵／task复刻／metrics。完整3168轮API执行及部分未公开collaborator技能不适合低成本忠实复现；保留协议与资产可用边界为审查DONE，不把私有skill目的描述冒充技能实现。 完整实验高成本不复现，不作能力证据。

comparison.position: Hand-picking the right skill measures a curated upper bound, not deployed discovery. SkillBuffBench crosses three access levels(none, curated, automatic) with two memory modes under fixed task/model/harness configurations, separating content benefit, discovery loss and memory interactions. Exact model and harness versions belong to each result cell.
comparison.tradeoff: Harness² generates and improves execution harnesses. SkillBuffBench measures paired differences across harness, model, access and memory conditions. Exposing test verifiers to improvement changes their information boundaries. Curated access must not be advertised as automatic discovery capability.

analysis.title: skillbuffbench: distinguish mechanism from capability
analysis.body: M0 resets workspace, session and memory namespace for every run; caches and history are not shared. API credentials may be reused. Prompts do not name skills, and gold values, references and verifiers are withheld. Network access defaults to model APIs with task-specific service allowlists. Unreleased skill contents cannot be reconstructed from purpose descriptions and called equivalent. Harness² generates and improves execution harnesses. SkillBuffBench measures paired differences across harness, model, access and memory conditions. Exposing test verifiers to improvement changes their information boundaries. Curated access must not be advertised as automatic discovery capability.

question.question: Why is it not the same experiment as Harness²?
question.answer: It holds configuration fixed while varying access and memory; Harness² actively edits a harness and accumulates experience. Evolution artifacts and evaluation factors are distinct.

comparison.position: 复杂任务产物可能是Excel、PowerPoint或应用状态，单纯把文件转成文本会丢公式、布局与跨文件关系。本文不是新做任务的Agent，而是研究判断Agent产物的verifier：BVB包含24投资银行任务、2464个人工判定criteria，用来评测验证器的判断。

analysis.title: gandalf-bvb: distinguish mechanism from capability
analysis.body: Gandalf reactively chooses native artifacts and tools needed for each rubric criterion until it returns a Boolean verdict. Environment alignment supplies read-only frozen-snapshot tools; corpus-wide domain guidance supplies banking conventions, not task answers. The judge must not mutate the artifact and then pass its own repaired result. AskALCF separates answer quality from retrieval sufficiency for attribution. Gandalf judges completed deliverables against rubrics. Both need independent evidence but their roles differ. Judge snapshots must not become actor-visible gold, and judges must not write artifacts. comparison.position: 本文不先指定GEPA式优化循环，而是给冻结teacher通用自改进目标、文件读写／Bash／gameplay原语与资源预算。teacher可自己造游戏、观察短生命周期player、编辑文本产物，自行决定何时探索、比较和更新。真实游戏与外部benchmark不在teacher训练访问范围。

comparison.position: Instead of prescribing a GEPA-style optimization loop, this study gives a frozen teacher a general improvement goal, file/Bash/gameplay primitives and resource budgets. It may create games, inspect ephemeral players and edit text artifacts, choosing when to explore, compare and update. Real games and external benchmark labels are excluded from teacher training access.
comparison.tradeoff: ELITE prescribes explore-then-integrate while excluding downstream outcomes; this study deliberately omits an imposed optimization loop and lets the teacher choose learning actions. Harness² has its own predefined Propose–Probe–Compose. A scaffold protocol can support research without reproducing emergent learning capability. Full multi-model long-rollout evaluation is not reproduced due to cost(reviewDONE).

analysis.title: self-organized-learning: distinguish mechanism from capability
analysis.body: A teacher organizes learning within a persistent session; each player uses a fresh session and current text artifacts. Weights remain fixed. The paper analyzes emergent curricula, difficulty selection and A/B testing and tests transfer across game horizons, mechanics and3D navigation. Feedback on self-generated games is not access to final external test labels. ELITE prescribes explore-then-integrate while excluding downstream outcomes; this study deliberately omits an imposed optimization loop and lets the teacher choose learning actions. Harness² has its own predefined Propose–Probe–Compose. A scaffold protocol can support research without reproducing emergent learning capability. Full multi-model long-rollout evaluation is not reproduced due to cost(reviewDONE).
